mapper.select: SELECT dlh.dtDttmH, ROUND(SUM( CASE WHEN m.dValidInstrInteger IS NULL OR m.dValidInstrInteger = 0 OR dlh.dFapDiff IS NULL OR dlh.dFapDiff = 0 THEN 0 ELSE dlh.dFapDiff / m.dValidInstrInteger END ), 0) AS usage FROM data_lp5_hour dlh LEFT JOIN meter_tmp2 m ON dlh.mid = m.mid WHERE dlh.dtDttm = #{today} GROUP BY dlh.dtDttmH ORDER BY dlh.dtDttmH ASC

SELECT ROUND(SUM( CASE WHEN m.dValidInstrInteger IS NULL OR m.dValidInstrInteger = 0 OR dld.dFapDiff IS NULL OR dld.dFapDiff = 0 THEN 0 ELSE dld.dFapDiff / m.dValidInstrInteger END ), 0) AS usage FROM data_lp5_day dld LEFT JOIN meter_tmp2 m ON dld.mid = m.mid WHERE 1 = 1
AND dld.dtDttm BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT dld.dtDttm, ROUND(SUM( CASE WHEN m.dValidInstrInteger IS NULL OR m.dValidInstrInteger = 0 OR dld.dFapDiff IS NULL OR dld.dFapDiff = 0 THEN 0 ELSE dld.dFapDiff / m.dValidInstrInteger END ), 0) AS usage FROM data_lp5_day dld LEFT JOIN meter_tmp2 m ON dld.mid = m.mid WHERE 1 = 1 AND dld.dtDttm >= #{thisYearStart} GROUP BY dld.dtDttm ORDER BY dld.dtDttm ASC
